change: replace the uncalibrated theoretical one-sample t decision with a studentized equal-species mean statistic whose final p-value is Monte Carlo calibrated against independent synthetic null worlds; all information thresholds, alpha and effect floor are unchanged

predictor_information.per_species_unique_fraction: variance fraction of z(M_host) remaining after intercept + z(M_self) + z(D_host_0BP)

primary_statistic.per_species: standardized partial beta_host_s from z(turnover) ~ z(M_host) + z(M_self) + z(D_host_0BP)

synthetic_qualification.null_structure: preserve exact graph geometry and frozen predictors; simulate endpoint-dependent within-species responses with ordinary IBD, private spatial structure, nuisance effects of M_self and D_host_0BP, and zero mean host-memory effect
synthetic_qualification.positive_structure: same world family plus species host-memory effects with mean standardized beta_host=0.10 and between-species SD=0.10
synthetic_qualification.primary_p_value: (1 + number of independent null-reference aggregate statistics >= observed aggregate statistic)/(1 + null_reference_worlds)
synthetic_qualification.private_type1_gate: Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate <=0.10 over evaluation null worlds
synthetic_qualification.positive_power_gate: Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate >=0.80 over positive worlds
